title: Bishop Guards the Gift
setup: Black's king on g7 is shielded by a single pawn on f7, and your bishop on h5 is watching that square.
hint: The pawn shielding the king seems defended only by the king. What else of yours covers that square?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qxf7+}} works because the bishop on **h5** covers f7, so the king may not capture. The rook on e6 has already taken g6 and h6 away, so {{Kh8}} is forced, and {{Rh6#}} swings across to mate down the h-file.
